meta.name: eol-message
meta.description: Write a clear, empathetic EOL announcement with rationale, customer impact, and next steps. Use when retiring a product, feature, or plan without creating avoidable confusion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写清晰共情的产品退市公告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备通知用户某个产品或功能即将停止服务
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to communicate the end of life of a product or feature

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude会按EOL消息框架撰写产品/功能停用公告，包含公司背景、公告、理由、客户影响、过渡方案、支持措施、时间线和行动号召，语气清晰且富有同理心。
howto.when: 当你需要宣布产品、功能或服务停用，并且已有完整的过渡计划时触发。

say.text: 写一封给客户的邮件，通知他们WFM软件将在6个月后停用。
say.note: Claude会包含客户影响和迁移步骤。

say.text: 起草一个API停用通知，替换方案是新的API v2。
say.note: Claude会加入时间线和支持措施。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude will write a clear, empathetic EOL announcement covering company context, announcement, rationale, customer impact, transition solution, support measures, timeline, and call to action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to announce end-of-life for a product, feature, or service, and have a complete transition plan ready.

say_en.text: Write an EOL announcement for Acme Classic, replacement is Pro, deadline end of 2026.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full EOL message.

say_en.text: Compose a customer email notifying that WFM software will be discontinued in 6 months.
say_en.note: Claude will include impact and migration steps.

say_en.text: Draft an API deprecation notice, replacement is new API v2.
say_en.note: Claude will add timeline and support measures.
